prompt:
A single front-on pit board plate, flat vector print, filling a 4:3 frame. Background outside the plate is flat solid #0A0A0A, visible only past the plate corners. No photograph, no scene, no perspective, no shadow, no gloss, no track, no people outside the logo.

Regions in this order:
1. Plate body: a wide rounded-rectangle vinyl board, face #FFFFFF, about 92% of the frame, thin outline #0A0A0A.
2. Two black handle slots, horizontal rounded capsules, one upper-left and one upper-right on the white face.
3. A flat orange #FF9430 chevron entering from the left edge only, pointing right, occupying the outer left 15% of the plate, vertically centered on the lower half. It stops before the middle.
4. A matching orange chevron from the right edge, pointing left, outer right 15% only.
5. Along the bottom center of the white face, small: the reference square logo (orange rounded square, motocross rider, crosshair corners) and the word HOLESHOT in heavy black condensed caps to its right. The reference is only that logo. No bike or rider anywhere else.
6. The middle of the plate, from about 22% to 78% across and from under the handles down to above the word, is empty white. No stripes, no banner, no spear, no numbers, no URL, no word RIDER.

Hard edges, print flat, orthographic.
